skills.name: inbox-pipeline
skills.description: Full inbox processing chain: hydrate stubs, claude triage, youtube transcripts, index, todoist sync, daily/weekly catchup.

skills.name: daily-pipeline
skills.description: Marker-gated daily synthesis: retry crawls, enrich transcripts, index, claude daily synthesis, signal queue, todoist sync.

skills.name: weekly-pipeline
skills.description: Marker-gated weekly synthesis: retry crawls, claude weekly synthesis, index, signal, audit, enrich, profile.

skills.name: fetch-stubs
skills.description: Hydrate mobile web clipper stubs via Cloudflare /crawl. Deduplicates against vault. Retry mode for failed crawls with exponential backoff.

skills.name: summarize-transcripts
skills.description: Enrich YouTube transcripts and web clips with Claude-generated Research Context sections + auto-extracted domain tags.

skills.name: sync-todoist
skills.description: Push new todo notes to Todoist API. Pull completed tasks back. Routes by #work/#personal tags to project IDs.

skills.name: generate-signal
skills.description: Score unconsumed notes by assertion overlap, rising topics, and recency. Generate signal/queue.md read queue dashboard.

skills.name: enrich-topics
skills.description: Generate research briefs for topics reaching critical mass (5+ notes). Optional web research via Cloudflare /crawl.

skills.name: profile-entities
skills.description: Auto-generate profiles for people, companies, concepts with 5+ vault mentions. Regex NER + Claude pre-filter.

skills.name: audit-links
skills.description: Scan vault for broken [[wikilinks]]. Output report to _meta/broken-links.md.

skills.name: rag-index
skills.description: Embed vault notes into LanceDB vector store. Drop+recreate strategy. BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 embeddings.

slash_commands.name: reflect
slash_commands.description: Interactive vault exploration + original thinking session

slash_commands.name: research
slash_commands.description: Trigger research enrichment pipeline for a topic or note

slash_commands.name: signal
slash_commands.description: Curated reading recommendations from signal queue

slash_commands.name: plunge
slash_commands.description: Stochastic deep dive into vault history

slash_commands.name: drift
slash_commands.description: Neutral mirror: gap between stated intentions and actual attention

slash_commands.name: object
slash_commands.description: Adversarial friction: argue against a position using vault evidence

slash_commands.name: source
slash_commands.description: Trace the evolution of an idea through the vault chronologically

slash_commands.name: surface
slash_commands.description: Rescue buried thinking from daily notes and fleeting captures

bootstrap_note: To bootstrap into a new vault: mind-palace init creates directory structure, generates CLAUDE.md + slash commands from templates, writes mind-palace.toml config, and optionally installs LaunchAgents. Scripts are bundled in the Go binary.
